name: mplads-audit-intelligence-unified
description: SIH26102 — MPLADS Audit Intelligence Unified System (Person 1 Data+Backend, Person 2 Risk+ML, Person 3 NLP+Graph+Geo, Person 4 Frontend)

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:person2: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const res = spawnSync('python', ['-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-v'], { cwd: 'person2-risk-pipeline', stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status);"
scripts.test:person3: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const res = spawnSync('python', ['-m', 'unittest', 'tests/test_person3_integration.py', '-v'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status);"
scripts.test: npm run test:person1 && npm run test:person2
scripts.test:all: npm run test:person1 && npm run test:person2 && npm run test:person3
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix person1 run lint && npm --prefix person4-frontend run typecheck
